_comment: Single source of truth for macro indicators (Plan A Tier 1). NOT YET wired into index.html render — see PLAN-macro-json.md for remaining steps. Each value carries a 'source' = the FRED / Trading Economics series ID it will auto-fetch from in Tier 2.

us10y.label: US 10Y Treasury
us10y.note: ticked back up this week (briefly a 19-month high near 4.75%) as some of the Sept-cut certainty faded; Jackson Hole (late Aug) is still the next big signal

fedFunds.label: Fed Funds Rate
fedFunds.note: July NFP +22K (vs +75K exp.), unemployment 4.3% (highest since Oct 2021) — weak print firms up Sept-cut odds ahead of Jackson Hole

usCPI.label: US CPI (YoY)
usCPI.note: disinflation resuming off May's 4.2%; supports easing

usPCE.label: US PCE (YoY)
usPCE.note: cooled vs prior; supports the easing-path tone

dxy.label: Dollar Index (DXY)
dxy.note: holding near 99.6–99.8, firmer than the soft-dollar case despite the yield backdrop; a break back below 98 is what would broaden EM/commodity relief

source.caveat: DXY proper is ICE; DTWEXBGS is FRED's broad trade-weighted USD index — close proxy, label accordingly

biRate.label: Bank Indonesia Rate
biRate.note: rupiah still firmer vs. the spring lows, but MSCI's August review trimmed Indonesia's index weight (11 removals, effective after 31 Aug) — a fresh headwind against the 'recovery matured' read

usdidr.label: USD/IDR
usdidr.delta: BI hike works, MSCI outflow risk
usdidr.note: rupiah holding firmer as the hike takes hold, but the MSCI August rebalancing (11 IDX removals, effective after 31 Aug) is a new passive-outflow risk to watch

gold.label: Gold (XAU)
gold.note: holding in the $4,370–4,440 band, near record levels reached two weeks ago — still the relative-strength/haven asset while crypto and oil realign

source.caveat: no free FRED/TE daily series; keep manual or use a market-data API in a later tier

wti.label: WTI Crude
wti.note: reversed hard: the Iran–Oman Hormuz deal we'd flagged as de-escalation broke down into an active US naval blockade of Iran; WTI ripped back up to ~$82 (Brent ~$88.50) as real supply-risk premium returned
